additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
Nach einem Stromausfall lässt sich die Anlage nicht Neustarten.
Der Neustart bricht nach 86% ab
After a power outage, the system cannot be restarted.
The restart aborts after 86%.

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0444337-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S2 170003340] Unable To Reboot The Unit CRM:02699000182
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Teepe,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services team in regards of ticket
ID0444337.
The ticket was opened for issues at the booting phase of charger
MP/S2 170003340
, after the charger was shut off due to a power outage of the grid.
I just had a look at the charger remotely, on SCB and via SSH, and:
Charger does not seem to be in failsafe mode. Also, all controllers are reachable via ping remotely
From the error flags, I see two major ones:
All the other error flags seem to me a consequence of these two.
I believe that the charger experienced, due to the grid outage, an event of overvoltage or overcurrent or both.
It is necessary therefore to perform an inspection of the FA1 surge protection and of continuity of the fuses FC1, as per picture below from the circuit diagram (attached to this email):
Also, the second error flag is mentioning that one of the fuses on the 24V line has tripped. It is necessary to check which one tripped, verify if the fuse can be restored, and if there are further components tripped inside the charger:
I include in this email colleagues from region Germany of Siemens, who can coordinate the onsite visit if required from their side.
In the ticket it was mentioned that the booting phase of the charger was stopped at 86%. Was the charger boot-looping at 86%? At the moment I would exclude that the FW got corrupted due to the power outage.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei

Smart Infrastructure
